classification.split: LEGACY random slice-level validation split (NOT a held-out test set)
classification.dataset: Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (BRI), Training+Testing merged
warnings: These numbers come from the classifier checkpoint shipped with the repository, before the two-method refactor. They are real measurements, but their provenance is weaker than the current pipeline's.
The split was random at the slice level with no patient grouping, so near-duplicate images from one patient could appear in both training and validation. The score is therefore optimistic.
It is the split that early stopping also selected on, so it is a model-selection score, not a held-out test score.
It was measured with the legacy whole-slice geometry (transform m1-v1-legacy). Retrain with `python -m backend.methods.method1.training.train_classifier` for a real held-out test number.
No segmentation model was trained, so no Dice or IoU exists for Method 1.
